detached_structure.evidence: A gray-roofed building sits north of the central house, mostly behind tree canopy. It may be a neighboring lot's house or an outbuilding on the central lot.

signals.notes: The central ranch-style house has a dark gray roof with some visible weathering. Dense trees on the north side of the lot hide much of the yard, and the concrete driveway leads to the street with no vehicles parked on it.
